_readme: The reel's voiceover. Each line starts at a timeline mark (see reel-timing.json). Parts are spoken in order with the given pause after each (seconds) and speaking rate (words per minute, used only by the placeholder TTS). A recorded voice should follow the same starting marks.

parts: Namaskaram,
I'm Vimala Banavath,
a Senior Product Designer.
I design digital products across AI, enterprise, and real-world operations,
turning complex problems into experiences people can actually use.
Sometimes, that means designing the system.
And sometimes,
building it myself.
For enterprise products,
I focus on making complexity clearer, faster, and easier to navigate.
I've also worked on consumer experiences,
where every interaction needs to feel effortless.
And some projects start with ambiguity.
Understanding people first,
then designing the experience around what they actually need.
I started with a simple question.
What if your career could understand itself?
Today, our professional story is scattered
across résumés, portfolios, profiles and applications.
Career Intelligence explores a different model.
Evidence becomes capability,
capability becomes opportunity,
and signals shape the next move.
I explored it as one system:
six intelligence layers, and more than thirty product surfaces.
Two of them are working today.
The first working experiment is narrower.
What does your work actually prove?
It reads a claim against the evidence.
Where excerpts converge, a signal.
Where they're thin, a gap,
and one next move.
Then: what happens after you press send?
We can observe behaviour.
We cannot know intent.
The portfolio is only the beginning.
My thesis for twenty thirty:
the career profile may no longer be a document.
It may become a living intelligence layer.
Career Intelligence is an exploration of what that could look like.
For me, good product design starts before the screen.
It's about understanding the system,
making complexity easier to navigate,
and building experiences people can trust.
I'm Vimala Banavath.
Senior Product Designer.
